title: String nets for twisted pivotal categories
summary: We develop a graphical calculus for monoidal categories equipped with twisted pivotal structures, which are a generalization of pivotal structures originating from the study of orientation structures in the context of the Cobordism Hypothesis. This graphical calculus depends on a possibly singular foliation, and we use it to construct twisted string net modules for surfaces equipped with a Morse function or a Morse foliation.
